subject: Mobile Development
title: Ambient Computing: No Device Needed
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Ambient Computing: No Device Needed.

hook.text: What if computing was everywhere — in the walls, furniture, and air — and you needed no device?

buildup.text: Ambient computing embeds intelligence into the environment: speakers, displays, and sensors everywhere.

discovery.text: Amazon Echo, Google Nest, and smart displays create computing experiences without holding anything.

twist.text: Ambient computing requires constant listening, raising enormous privacy and surveillance concerns.

climax.text: The phone may not disappear — it may just dissolve into the environment around you.

punchline.text: Computing disappears into the world around you.

quiz.question: What is ambient computing?
options: Intelligence embedded in the environment requiring no device
